name: pactmandev/nonprofit-check-plus
description: Official PHP SDK for the Pactman Nonprofit Check Plus API — verify US nonprofits by EIN against IRS BMF, Publication 78, Automatic Revocation and OFAC data.

suggest.psr/http-client: Send requests through your own PSR-18 client — a shared pool, a proxy, pinned certificates — instead of the bundled cURL transport.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at max level over src, tests, examples and scripts.
scripts-descriptions.mock: Serve the bundled fixture API on http://127.0.0.1:8787.
scripts-descriptions.examples:smoke: Run every documented example against the bundled fixture API.
scripts-descriptions.smoke:live: Check a live deployment against src/response-contract.json and src/response-baseline.json.
scripts-descriptions.baseline:record: Re-record src/response-baseline.json from production. Spends billable checks; commit the result.
